facts.business: Bemco Hydraulics Limited designs, develops, and manufactures custom-built, application-specific hydraulic machines for sectors including automotive, railways, aeronautics, defense, forging, and foundry.

capacity_or_capex.item: Infrastructure development and induction of new technology

guidance_or_targets.statement: Confident and looking forward to a bright future and growth with planned larger investments on infrastructure development and induction of new technology.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpt (Signature/Partner name missing)

key_risks: Long working capital cycle (6-10 months) leading to high inventory and interest costs
Inability to reduce specialized workforce during downturns
Dependence on government orders with long decision cycles (180+ days) and blocked earnest money/security deposits
Risk of reduced import duties hurting domestic competitiveness
Prolonged disputes/arbitration blocking inventory and deposits
High bank interest rates relative to developed countries eroding earnings
Competition from small entrepreneurs in smaller capacity machines
Need for constant technological innovation and energy-efficient intelligent machines
Buyer default risk: private entrepreneurs not taking delivery of ready custom machines
